From the kitchen

Photos from the bar’s own Google listing.

36 Bay Street on Finikoudes

36 Bay Street sits on Athenon Street, the Finikoudes seafront in Larnaca, behind the brick front with the “36 Bay Street” lettering. Inside, many screens show the matches, and guests on Google write about the terrace with a view of the sea. The kitchen runs from nachos and wings to grilled pork chop, souvlaki, salmon and burgers.

Open every day from noon, on weekends from 11 in the morning. Draught beers, cocktails and shisha.

What guests say

Four of 741 Google reviews, 4.2 stars on average.
